objective: Verify a loaded self-accepted ESM entry still updates in process after its watcher baseline was changed to the exact source read during startup
method: A live target/debug/quench-node --hmr process loaded a self-accepted .mjs entry, then the entry was replaced with generation 2. The process output and PID were observed.
scope: One focused macOS regression smoke. It confirms the normal startup and accepted-update path; it does not force an edit into the narrow interval between source read and host setup.
result: Generation 2 was applied in the original PID with no diagnostics.
